label: Manual observation failure taxonomy
description: Failure classes for human-operated external baseline observations. These classes preserve uncertainty and prevent pending or weak observations from becoming fabricated evidence.

classes.label: Source gap
classes.meaning: The relevant source, collection, or authority appears absent from the compared evidence surface.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the likely useful source is missing or not represented.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for rank-only problems when the source is present but buried.
classes.example_note: Relevant archive collection was not visible in the observed top results.

classes.label: Capability gap
classes.meaning: The system lacks the search capability needed to express the need.
classes.when_to_use: Use when member-level, compatibility, date, or metadata filtering cannot be performed.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the query was ambiguous but the system capability was adequate.
classes.example_note: The observed system could not search inside container members.

classes.label: Ranking gap
classes.meaning: Useful evidence appears to exist but is not ranked early enough to be helpful.
classes.when_to_use: Use when a good result is visible only after less useful results.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when no useful result was visible at all.
classes.example_note: A useful source appeared below several generic download pages.

classes.label: Extraction gap
classes.meaning: Source content exists but needed metadata, member, snippet, or text extraction is missing.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the observed source likely contains evidence that is not extracted or exposed.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the source itself is absent.
classes.example_note: The archive item existed but member filenames were not exposed.

classes.label: Compatibility gap
classes.meaning: Compatibility target, operating system, hardware, version, or runtime support is unclear.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the result does not answer the compatibility part of the need.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for unrelated identity ambiguity.
classes.example_note: The result did not clarify whether it supports the requested OS version.

classes.label: Representation gap
classes.meaning: The result is represented at the wrong level or with insufficient structure.
classes.when_to_use: Use for parent-vs-member, package-vs-file, or page-vs-object mismatches.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for source absence.
classes.example_note: The parent CD image was visible but the requested driver file was not.

classes.label: Identity gap
classes.meaning: The observed result cannot be confidently tied to the intended object or source.
classes.when_to_use: Use for ambiguous titles, renamed projects, duplicate objects, or unclear provenance.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when identity is clear but rights or policy blocks access.
classes.example_note: Multiple similarly named utilities appeared with no clear authoritative match.

classes.label: Temporal or version gap
classes.meaning: The relevant time window, release boundary, or version line is unclear.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the query depends on before/after, latest-compatible, or historical version context.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for general ranking weakness.
classes.example_note: The result did not distinguish the last release before platform support ended.

classes.label: Rights or policy block
classes.meaning: Rights, robots, terms, account, takedown, or access policy blocks evaluation.
classes.when_to_use: Use when policy prevents recording or validating enough evidence.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use to imply rights clearance.
classes.example_note: The result required an account or blocked public inspection.

classes.label: Query interpretation gap
classes.meaning: The system interpreted the query differently from the intended need.
classes.when_to_use: Use when visible results target another meaning of the query.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the query itself is too ambiguous for all systems.
classes.example_note: The results focused on modern apps rather than old-platform-compatible software.

classes.label: Near match only
classes.meaning: A related result is visible but does not satisfy the need.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the result is useful context but not the answer.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for a fully satisfying result.
classes.example_note: A similar hardware model appeared, but not the requested model.

classes.label: Noisy result list
classes.meaning: The visible result set is broad, spammy, mixed, or hard to triage.
classes.when_to_use: Use when noise materially increases user cost.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for a focused list with one bad rank.
classes.example_note: Generic download pages dominated the observed top results.

classes.label: Dead link or unavailable
classes.meaning: A visible result points to a dead, blocked, removed, or unavailable locator.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the result cannot be reviewed at the visible locator.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for a live page with weak evidence.
classes.example_note: The visible result linked to a page that no longer loaded.

classes.label: Ambiguous need
classes.meaning: The query or task lacks enough context for fair evaluation.
classes.when_to_use: Use when multiple interpretations are plausible and cannot be resolved from the slot.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the system clearly misinterpreted a specific need.
classes.example_note: The query did not identify whether software, documentation, or drivers were wanted.

classes.label: External baseline unavailable
classes.meaning: The named external baseline could not be manually reached or searched.
classes.when_to_use: Use when the system itself was unavailable, blocked, or not safely accessible.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use for a reachable system with no useful results.
classes.example_note: The external system was unavailable during the manual session.

classes.label: Observation incomplete
classes.meaning: The manual session occurred but required fields are missing.
classes.when_to_use: Use before review when a record needs completion.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use to approve a partial observed record.
classes.example_note: The record has a title and rank but lacks locator and usefulness note.

classes.label: Not evaluable
classes.meaning: The slot cannot be evaluated under the current protocol.
classes.when_to_use: Use when policy, ambiguity, unavailable systems, or missing context prevents scoring.
classes.when_not_to_use: Do not use merely because the result is poor.
classes.example_note: The slot required a credentialed account and cannot be evaluated publicly.

notes: Failure classes are evidence labels, not automatic work orders.
No class implies exhaustive search or accepted public truth.
